objective: Bring a mug of Southshore Stout to Valik in the Syndicate camp.

description: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy.
No doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
progress: Did you bring me something to drink or did you just come back to finish the job?
completion: Given my impending death, I think I can safely say that this is the sweetest tasting thing ever... Here, take this, won't do me any good when I'm dead.
